explained.0.0: axis tick of a node's spectrum plot or a Qt Easy Mode table cell; tick labels follow the plot's zoom and are not controls
explained.1.0: axis tick / the Qt Easy Mode dye-table cell value 1.0 (qy and ec default to 1.0 when the catalogue gives none); the emtk Easy tab shows them in input fields
explained.10.8: axis tick of a node plot (depends on zoom)
explained.autorecalculate: Qt Easy Mode 'Auto recalculate' check box -> the 'Auto update' toggle of the Backend panel (it queues a simulation after every graph or Easy Mode edit, the same rule)
explained.c1: Easy Mode form: drawn by the shared chisurf.emtk.optical_configuration widget (another stream's, not edited here). the Qt detector table's channel column header C1; the emtk form lists each detector by its name
explained.detectors: Easy Mode form: drawn by the shared chisurf.emtk.optical_configuration widget (another stream's, not edited here). the Qt section header 'Detectors'; the emtk form lists the detectors (name, bandpass, quantum efficiency) and has Add / Remove buttons
explained.ec: Easy Mode form: drawn by the shared chisurf.emtk.optical_configuration widget (another stream's, not edited here). the Qt dye table column EC -> input 'Extinction coefficient'
explained.exci.dichroic: Easy Mode form: drawn by the shared chisurf.emtk.optical_configuration widget (another stream's, not edited here). the Qt 'Exci. Dichroic' list header -> combo 'Excitation dichroic'
explained.fluorophores: Easy Mode form: drawn by the shared chisurf.emtk.optical_configuration widget (another stream's, not edited here). the Qt section header 'Fluorophores' -> 'Add fluorophore' combo and one block per dye
explained.kappa²: Easy Mode form: drawn by the shared chisurf.emtk.optical_configuration widget (another stream's, not edited here). the Qt kappa² spin box -> slider 'Orientation factor κ²'
explained.lasers: Easy Mode form: drawn by the shared chisurf.emtk.optical_configuration widget (another stream's, not edited here). the Qt 'Lasers:' field -> 'Laser lines wavelength:power:'
explained.pmt(flatqe): Easy Mode form: drawn by the shared chisurf.emtk.optical_configuration widget (another stream's, not edited here). the Qt QE table lists every catalogue entry as a row; the emtk form offers them in the 'Quantum efficiency' combo, whose entries show only while it is open
explained.qe: Easy Mode form: drawn by the shared chisurf.emtk.optical_configuration widget (another stream's, not edited here). the Qt QE column header -> combo 'Quantum efficiency'
explained.qy: Easy Mode form: drawn by the shared chisurf.emtk.optical_configuration widget (another stream's, not edited here). the Qt dye table column QY -> input 'Quantum yield'
explained.recalculate: Qt Easy Mode 'Recalculate' button -> the Easy tab's 'Simulate optical setup' button and the results window's 'Calculate Emission Intensity'
explained.simulation: Easy Mode form: drawn by the shared chisurf.emtk.optical_configuration widget (another stream's, not edited here). the Qt section header 'Simulation' -> the 'Simulate optical setup' button and the results tables
explained.template2-color(2detector): Easy Mode form: drawn by the shared chisurf.emtk.optical_configuration widget (another stream's, not edited here). the Qt template buttons -> entries of the 'Built-in template' combo
